scope: Existing managed I2C and completion_delivery/EventExecutor composed without header changes; two fixed source callbacks, each with one token FIFO
backend_precondition: serialized, cooperative non-revocable Domain leases; declared pins.ready; IRQ-off register access; no DMA; all objects outlive loans
completion: backend register stop/drain -> explicit reap -> retained result and outer buffer -> explicit user take
resource_release: explicit close only, after no Queued/Running records; outer Terminal results do not prevent close
source_identity: Request tokens are Manager-local. Each target callback is permanently scoped to one live Manager. Deliberate cross-source misrouting is recorded as a counterexample, not made safe.
delivery: Explicit reap -> pending retained through pump -> callback revalidates notice and takes result. Peripheral close and clock changes do not imply callback execution.
